title: I have real concerns about superstition

top_liked.author: @jwoods5460
top_liked.text: I agree. Believing in superstition and supernatural forces not only wastes time and effort but keeps people from addressing the core causes of their reality.

top_liked.author: @MultiShell12
top_liked.text: Yes! I feel I wasted many years with a vicious cycle of magical thinking. So glad to be in a better place!

top_liked.author: @ApostateSisters
top_liked.text: Yes yes yes! Superstition blinds to reality!!

top_liked.author: @ryanrevland4333
top_liked.text: In reality,  Let go and Let God, is just letting go.

top_liked.author: @ChipPayet
top_liked.text: You have no idea how much I love hearing you discuss the harms of superstitious thinking!

top_liked.author: @andrewfrennier3494
top_liked.text: I remember when you used to be able to buy lucky rabbit’s feet in department and convenience stores to hang on your keychain.

top_liked.author: @mariobethell3731
top_liked.text:
Covid-19 proved that none of those promises given to believers were effective. When churches were closed, hospitals were open using the science of the day because those biblical promises did not work.

          John 15:7
7 If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall…

top_liked.author: @jonmeador8637
top_liked.text:
“The foundation of our empire was not laid in the gloomy age of ignorance and superstition.” George Washington

Why then is it still around or legal? George Washington would ask.
